entities.summary: Dattatreya Hosabale is the current Sarkaryavah of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS), a Hindutva paramilitary organisation, since 2021. He had previously served as the Sangathan Mantri of the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP), a student wing of the RSS.
